notes: § 1410 ensures the means of proving authentication under § 1400 are not artificially limited.
§ 1401 requires authentication; § 1410 ensures the methods available to satisfy that requirement are open-ended.
§ 1411 (testimony of subscribing witness) is one enumerated means; § 1410 confirms this list is illustrative.
§ 1412 (testimony of witness to the execution) is one enumerated means.
§ 1413 (witness to handwriting) is one enumerated means.
§ 1414 (opinion of handwriting expert) is one enumerated means.
§ 1415 (handwriting comparison by trier of fact) is one enumerated means.
§ 1416 (admission of authenticity) is one enumerated means.
§ 1417 (comparison of handwriting) is one enumerated means.
§ 1418 (evidence of authenticity of ancient writing) is one enumerated means.
§ 1420 (authentication by content) is one enumerated means.
§ 1421 (authentication by reply letter) is one enumerated means.
